description: Rename a scene (the name the person sees in the scene list and the timeline). Names don't have to be unique and change nothing else in the film. One undo step for the person. Fails if the scene isn't found or the name is empty. Returns { done }. Shots have no names; scenes are listed by get_project.

name.description: The new name, like 'The chase'. Short is best; it can't be empty.

name: rename_scene
